details.description: Indulge in the rich and smooth taste of the Baskin Robbins Real Belgian Hazelnut Chocolate Milkshake. This delightful 200ml flavoured milk offers a luxurious blend of Belgian chocolate and hazelnut, creating a truly unique and satisfying treat. Free from added preservatives, artificial flavours, and colours, it delivers an authentic and indulgent experience. Shake well and enjoy it chilled for the best taste. Experience the irresistible combination of creamy chocolate and nutty hazelnut, with a rich texture that is sure to satisfy your sweet cravings. This milkshake is made with real Belgian chocolate, offering a decadent and high-quality taste that will transport you to a world of pure indulgence.
